Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable)
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-09-30T08:05Z against `origin/main`.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: the enum arm widens a published output type (consumers of `reason` must stay exhaustive), and `engine.validate` refusing an unknown key it used to pass narrows it. Both are read; the spec seat is told in this act.
- #5930 step 2 (PR #20794, queued) and #20768 edit other regions of `engine.ts`; whichever lands second merges `main`.
